title: Editorial calendar
summary: Plans a sustainable publishing schedule for books, newsletters, podcasts, blogs or social: pillars, realistic cadence, back-scheduled dependencies, buffers, key dates and repurposing.
changes: Borrowed from coreyhaines31 content-strategy: the 3-5 content pillars idea and ways to find them (product/audience/search/competitor-led), the weighted idea-scoring table (40/30/20/10, renamed to neutral factors), the 60/30/10 starting mix, and the create-once/distribute-many repurposing principle.
